We are a full-service marketing and creative agency, but we are so much more than that.

Michigan Creative is the only risk-taking creative agency unlocking custom, original solutions for innovative entrepreneurs and industry disruptors in the Midwest, who want an elite vibe to stand out in an era of automated band-aid solutions and run-of-the-mill online noise. National reach. Midwest values. Detroit grit.

We have the experience and capabilities to lead your marketing initiatives from branding, graphic design, and advertising to all facets of video production, animation, web, and social media.

Welcome to Michigan Creative! We can’t wait to create with you.
